- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Tips for writing a successful grant application to the RSE include:
  1. Carefully read the application guidelines.
  2. Clearly state your objectives.
  3. Demonstrate the novelty and feasibility of your project.
  4. Highlight the expected impact of your project.
  5. Write concisely and avoid jargon.
  6. Follow all the instructions.
  7. Seek feedback from a mentor or colleague.
